latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Editor Gaming — fast highlight editing for gamers.

- Upload raw gaming footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and describe how you want it edited.
- Automatically cuts highlights, adds transitions, syncs background music, and renders 1080p MP4, all in the cloud.
- Simple session and token management; free credits for new users.
- Supports instant exports, track previews, and various file formats.
- Built for creators needing quick, shareable highlight reels with minimal effort.
